landing.eyebrow: Corporate learning platform for personal finance · B2B UX/UI design case
landing.disclaimer: Educational content. It is not financial advice or an investment recommendation.

hero.body: A corporate learning platform shaped like a digital wallet: each person gets a practice salary, pays, budgets, saves and invests with fictitious money, and learns at the right moment. The company sees learning progress, never the amounts.
hero.fuerte: Hi, I'm Fuerte. Money in this wallet is for practice, so making mistakes is free.

pieces.kpiLabel: People who passed the level 1 challenge
pieces.practiceBody: Fictitious money, real decisions: every mistake ends in an explanation.

problem.title: Three questions many people ask at the end of the month

budget.title: Will my salary last the month?
budget.body: Without tracking expenses, the salary goes without knowing where.

inflation.title: Inflation eats my savings
inflation.body: Idle money loses purchasing power month after month.

card.title: I don't know what my card really costs
card.body: Installments, nominal rate (TNA) and total financial cost (CFT) look alike, and they are not.

solution.title: Not a course: a wallet that teaches
solution.intro: Each section unlocks with achievements and goals. The unlock order is the content: first what protects you, then what makes you grow.

diagnostic.title: Diagnostic and a path by levels
diagnostic.body: "Conocerte" finds what you already know and proposes the path; "Ya sé esto" skips what you master.

guides.title: 5-minute guides with practice
guides.body: A situation with numbers, a worked example and a question with an explained answer.

challenges.title: Nine kinds of challenges
challenges.body: Calculations, branching cases, ordering and sorting, all accessible without dragging.

tools.title: Tools to try scenarios
tools.body: Twelve simulators with visible assumptions and example values, never "current rates".

goals.title: Pockets and goals
goals.body: Emergency fund and goals adjusted for inflation, in the same wallet.

panel.title: Tracking for tutors and L&D
panel.body: Aggregated learning progress, with at least 5 people per group. No amount leaves the browser.

anywhere.title: The same guide on Mariana's computer and on Diego's phone
anywhere.intro: Office staff learn in 15-minute slots; operational staff, in 5-minute breaks on their phones. The interface adapts to each one.
anywhere.desktop: Mariana, Operations Analyst, on the computer
anywhere.mobile: Diego, Warehouse Operator, on the phone
anywhere.guideTitle: Interest-free installments or a cash discount?
anywhere.guideBody: You are offered 12 interest-free installments or 15 % off. Which is better with 3 % monthly inflation?

roles.title: Explore the demo as the person you choose
roles.intro: Each journey signs in with a fictitious work account of Andina Servicios S.A.

mariana.does: Uses the wallet to organize her money and reach Invest.
mariana.explore: Account home, tools, pockets and the Invest lock with what is missing.

diego.does: Learns in 5-minute breaks on his phone.
diego.explore: Short missions, guides with practice and the bottom navigation bar.

andres.does: Supports his cohorts without seeing amounts or wallet locks.
andres.explore: Progress heat map, weekly challenges and most-missed questions.

paula.does: Sets up the program, uploads people and tracks adoption.
paula.explore: Dashboard with a privacy threshold, CSV upload and settings.

ricardo.does: Reads the program impact in aggregated data.
ricardo.explore: Report with reaction, learning and behavior (Kirkpatrick 1 to 3).

simulator.eyebrow: Try a simulator without signing in
simulator.title: How much does your money buy if you keep it idle?
simulator.intro: Change the amount, the scenario or the months and see how the result changes.

steps.eyebrow: Explore the demo in three steps
steps.title: From sign-in to the wallet in a minute

s1.title: Choose a journey
s1.body: Each role signs in with one click, with a simulated sign-in.

s2.title: Explore as that person
s2.body: Use "Ver como" to switch roles or load an example state.

s3.title: Read the case study
s3.body: The design process, the decisions and the documentation are published.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: No. It is educational content: it teaches concepts and lets you practice with scenarios. It never recommends specific products, institutions or investments.
faq.q2: What does the company see about each person?
faq.a2: Their learning progress: guides, challenges and completed levels. Never amounts, balances, habit answers or why a level is still locked.
faq.a3: No. Scenarios use example values labeled as such, with links to official sources to check the current ones.
faq.a4: The wallet companion: it warns before an avoidable mistake, explains after one and celebrates progress. It can be muted.
faq.a5: It is a portfolio prototype with fictitious data and no backend: everything you enter stays in your browser.

final.title: Choose a person and explore the wallet

footer.tagline: Corporate learning platform for personal finance. Prototype with fictitious data.
footer.credit: Design and development: Lourdes Pedaci, Experience Designer (Learning and UX/UI).
footer.resetBody: The example data of every person comes back and the session closes. What you did in this demo is erased from this browser.

sim3.title: Inflation and purchasing power
sim3.intro: See how much your money loses if you keep it idle, with an example inflation scenario.
sim3.fuerte: Try it with your practice salary. Then compare it with another scenario.

amount.helpSalary: Prefilled with your practice salary. Amount in pesos, for example: 100.000

chart.tableLabel: Purchasing power month by month, as a table

meaning.title: What this means
meaning.body: Inflation makes the same bill pay for fewer things. If you keep money without a return, you lose purchasing power even if the balance does not change. That is why it pays to compare your savings return with inflation.

assumptions.constant: Inflation is the same every month.
assumptions.noInterest: The money earns nothing: it is kept idle.
assumptions.examples: Example values for learning. Check current values in official sources.
